title: Solution Owner IT Cloud Infrastructure
description:
**Job Description**
 Infrastructure Subject Matter Expert (SME) will support end\-to\-end infra services in the public cloud. s part of operations, you will collaborate with architects, security teams, and end users to enhance, deploy, and support the database environment.
   

  

 EICS Public Cloud and Database Services, part of Nokia Digital Office EICS, follows a lifecycle\-based operating model that ensures end\-to\-end accountability across cloud service delivery for internal Nokia customers. Strategic planning and governance set the direction, solutions architecture translates that vision into scalable and secure designs, DevOps automation accelerates consistent delivery, and operations management maintains service reliability — all connected through a continuous feedback loop that drives ongoing improvement and ensures services consistently meet the evolving needs of internal Nokia team
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Mange the resource running in Azure, GCP, AWS and OCI, provide expert L4 administration, configuration, and troubleshooting for Linux, UNIX, and Windows servers.
* Manage and optimize enterprise VMware vSphere environments, including ESXi, vCenter, and advanced features.
* Design, implement, and manage enterprise SAN, NAS, and Object Storage solutions, administer and optimize enterprise backup and recovery systems (e.g., Azure , GCBDR or any ).
* Develop, implement, and test disaster recovery strategies to meet RTO/RPO objectives, act as an escalation point for complex infrastructure issues, leading root cause analysis.
* Drive automation initiatives using scripting (Shell, Python, PowerShell) and configuration management tools, perform advanced system performance tuning, capacity planning, and resource optimization.
* Implement and enforce security policies, ensuring compliance across all managed systems, mentor junior team members and create comprehensive documentation for systems and procedures and cloud teams, ensuring strong stakeholder communication and alignment.
* Monitor system health, troubleshooting issues, and perform root cause analysis, collaborate with DevOps, and application teams to support database needs.
* Establish best practices for database reliability, scaling, and observability


**Key Skills And Experience**
* Graduate degree with 15\+ years' experience in UNIX, Solaris, Windows, Virtualization, Storage \& Backup platforms.
* OS Admin: Expert\-level administration, configuration, troubleshooting, performance tuning, patching, and automation for Linux, UNIX, and Windows Server environments, including Active Directory.
* Virtualization: Design, implement, and manage enterprise VMware vSphere (ESXi, vCenter, vSAN, NSX), ensuring VM lifecycle, performance, HA, and DR.
* Public Cloud: Manage resources across Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, with strong understanding of PaaS/IaaS, migration strategies, and hybrid cloud integration.
* Storage Management: Design, implement, and manage enterprise SAN/NAS/Object storage solutions (NetApp, EMC, HPE), monitoring performance and troubleshooting issues.
* Backup \& Recovery: Administer and optimize enterprise backup solutions (Azure, GCBDR, NetBackup, Rubrik), developing and testing DR strategies to meet RTO/RPO.
* Automation \& Scripting: Drive automation initiatives using Shell, Python, PowerShell, and configuration management tools like Ansible, Puppet, or Chef.
* Security \& Mentorship: Implement security policies, ensure compliance, provide L4 incident support, and mentor junior team members while maintaining documentation.


**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
 Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Nokia .
   

  

**Our recruitment process**
 We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.
   

  

 If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.
   

  

 The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .
   

  

**About The Team**
 Some of our benefits:
   

  

* Flexible and hybrid working schemes
* A minimum of 90 days of Maternity and Paternity Leave, with the option to return to work within a year following the birth or adoption of a child (based on eligibility)
* Life insurance to all employees to provide peace of mind and financial security
* Well\-being programs to support your mental and physical health
* Opportunities to join and receive support from Nokia Employee Resource Groups (NERGs)
* Employee Growth Solutions to support your personalized career \& skills development
* Diverse pool of Coaches \& Mentors to whom you have easy access
* A learning environment which promotes personal growth and professional development \- for your role and beyond

title: ERP Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 Sevalaya is a registered charitable trust established in 1988, working across multiple Indian states including Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala, Gujarat, Rajasthan, and Telangana. The organization focuses on education, healthcare, rural development, and welfare, positively impacting over one million people. Sevalaya is professionally managed and guided by a dedicated Board of Trustees from diverse professional backgrounds, all committed to social development. Team members join a mission\-driven environment that values compassion, integrity, and community service, with opportunities to engage closely with beneficiaries and local stakeholders. Interested individuals can learn more about Sevalaya’s work through its presence on Instagram and Facebook.
 



**Role Description** 
 The ERP Executive role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Tiruvallur. The ERP Executive will manage day\-to\-day ERP system operations, including data entry, validation, and maintenance of records related to programs, beneficiaries, finance, and administration. This role involves coordinating with various departments to understand process requirements, configuring and updating ERP modules, and ensuring timely and accurate reporting for internal and external stakeholders. The ERP Executive will troubleshoot system issues, liaise with vendors or technical teams as needed, and support staff in using the ERP system effectively through training and guidance. Additional responsibilities include monitoring system performance, enforcing data security and compliance, and contributing to process improvements that enhance efficiency and transparency.
 



**Job Description:** 




**\# Provide support and training to ERP users** 




**\# Maintain and manage the ERP system across various modules** 




**\# Assist in ERP implementation, upgrades, and regular updates** 




**\# Coordinate with internal teams to understand business requirements and translate them into ERP solutions** 




**\# Troubleshoot system issues and escalate to vendors when needed** 




**\# Monitor ERP system performance and ensure data integrity** 




**\# Prepare and maintain documentation, reports, and manuals** 




**\# Daily tasks and key functions** 




**\# Team structure and reporting manager**
